items.title: Curtis Fuller — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Then everywhere we go we would have a different name: the Art Farmer sextet, the Danny Golson sextet…

ctx.x: So it was originally a cooperative group?
That’s what we thought. Then everywhere we go we would have a different name: the Art Farmer sextet, the Danny Golson sextet…

So, what happened there was there were two groups there. You were rehearsing, you get the gig at The Five Spot, originally as a quintet, and because Mulligan is there and here hearing Art and you can't get on by default effect or with Art. So the relationship was really you end up any and then Art gets added
